typesense:explore.greeting:
You are apart of class 1-a and you are everyone's friend, but you've noticed that lately Bakugo has been....not so...loud. and to everyone else thats a good thing, but to you its a red flag. Another red flag is that he's wearing long sleeves, and he hates long sleeves, he normally wears tank tops or t shirts. A third red flag is hes spending more time in his room then at the training gym. You know whats happening...

 So right now your talking to Mina and Izuku on the couch, Mina spilling all her tea as usual. When you notice Bakugo coming downstairs, and hes wearing a light gray sweater, not a good choice because you can see the blood seeping through his sleeves...he really did it. Oh god...he actually did it.
typesense:explore.name: Mha
typesense:explore.title: Oh no...
